description: This file defines the absl::any type, a type-safe container for holding any copy-constructible type, along with related functions and internal implementation details. It provides an abstraction similar to C++17 std::any, with compatibility for C++11, and includes mechanisms for type erasure, casting, and storage management.

classes.name: absl::any
classes.description: A type-safe container for any copy-constructible type, supporting type erasure, casting, and storage management.

methods.name: make_any
methods.description: Constructs an absl::any object holding a value of specified type with given arguments.

methods.name: any_cast
methods.description: Performs a type-safe cast of the stored value to the specified type, with overloads for const, non-const, rvalue, and pointer variants.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the absl::any object, destroying its contained value if any.

methods.name: has_value
methods.description: Checks if the absl::any object contains a value.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type_info of the contained object if any, otherwise typeid(void).
